name: Draggable Sort Grid
description: Grid of labeled cards that can be dragged to reorder, with neighboring cards sliding into place and numbered badges updating live. Dragged cards lift with a shadow and accent border.
contents: Grid of draggable cards, each with an order badge, grip dots and a label
behavior: Cards are dragged with GSAP Draggable and snap to grid cells
Other cards animate to new cells as the dragged card crosses cells
Order badges renumber during the drag
Dragged card scales up with a deeper shadow and accent border
Card size shrinks to fit narrow screens and the grid rebuilds on resize
editableByProps: Card labels, grid columns, rows, gaps and card size
Card, border, text, muted and accent colors
fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Items beyond cols times rows are not shown
Item labels must be unique because they are used as keys
